cases.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.Country  =  T2.CountryId WHERE T2.CountryName  =  'france';

cases.question: List all cartoon directed by "Ben Jones".
cases.gold: SELECT Title FROM Cartoon WHERE Directed_by = "Ben Jones";

cases.question: Return the money rank of the player with the greatest earnings.
cases.gold: SELECT Money_Rank FROM poker_player ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many countries are listed?
cases.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM COUNTRIES;

cases.question: Count the number of templates of the type CV.
cases.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM Templates WHERE template_type_code  =  "CV"

cases.question: Return the name of the airport with code 'AKO'.
cases.gold: SELECT AirportName FROM AIRPORTS WHERE AirportCode  =  "AKO"

cases.question: Return the names of conductors that do not have the nationality "USA".
cases.gold: SELECT Name FROM conductor WHERE Nationality != 'USA'

cases.question: Which city has most number of departing flights?
cases.gold: SELECT T1.City FROM AIRPORTS AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T1.AirportCode  =  T2.SourceAirport GROUP BY T1.City ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which continent speaks the most languages?
cases.gold: SELECT T1.Continent FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Continent ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many cities in each district have a population that is above the average population across all cities?
cases.gold: SELECT count(*) ,  District FROM city WHERE Population  >  (SELECT avg(Population) FROM city) GROUP BY District

cases.question: Find the major and age of students who do not have a cat pet.
cases.gold: SELECT major ,  age FROM student WHERE stuid NOT IN (SELECT T1.stuid FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T3.petid  =  T2.petid WHERE T3.pettype  =  'cat')

cases.question: List the Episode of all TV series sorted by rating.
cases.gold: SELECT Episode FROM TV_series ORDER BY rating

cases.question: What are airport names at City 'Aberdeen'?
cases.gold: SELECT AirportName FROM AIRPORTS WHERE City = "Aberdeen"

cases.question: How many distinct nationalities are there?
cases.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT Nationality) FROM people

cases.question: What are 3 most highly rated episodes in the TV series table and what were those ratings?
cases.gold: SELECT Episode ,  Rating FROM TV_series ORDER BY Rating DESC LIMIT 3;

cases.question: What are the final tables made and best finishes for all poker players?
cases.gold: SELECT Final_Table_Made ,  Best_Finish FROM poker_player

cases.question: What is the number of nations that use English and Dutch?
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "Dutch")

cases.question: find the minimum and maximum number of products of all stores.
cases.gold: SELECT min(Number_products) ,  max(Number_products) FROM shop

cases.question: What are all the course names of the courses which ever have students enrolled in?
cases.gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id

cases.question: What are the names and descriptions of all the sections?
cases.gold: SELECT section_name ,  section_description FROM Sections
